reason: In packages/emails/email-manager.ts:525-550, sendAddGuestsEmails passes calendarEvent directly to AttendeeScheduledEmail and AttendeeAddGuestsEmail (lines 542-544) without clearing additionalNotes when calendarEvent.hideCalendarNotes is true (unlike sendScheduledEmails at line 119), and neither template nor BaseScheduledEmail checks hideCalendarNotes. Additionally, its caller in packages/trpc/server/routers/viewer/bookings/addGuests.handler.ts:124-147 omits hideCalendarNotes and forwards booking.description (where additionalNotes are persisted) directly into evt.description, exposing hidden notes to attendees.
